description_en: Modifies the name and description of a vRouter
description_zh: 调用ModifyVRouterAttribute接口修改路由器的名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vrouter-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vrouter-id vrt-gw0p7zigake75znix0000 --vrouter-name VRouter-1 --description My_VRouter --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVRouterAttribute

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the vRouter to modify.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
parameters.description_zh:
要修改的路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。

parameters.description_en:
The name of the vRouter.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
